items.q: Which sphere of the Earth is the layer of air?
items.qAf: Watter sfeer van die aarde is die laag lug?
items.explain: The atmosphere is the gas layer around the Earth; the hydrosphere is water, the lithosphere is rock and soil.
items.explainAf: Die atmosfeer is die gaslaag om die aarde; die hidrosfeer is water, die litosfeer is rots en grond.

items.q: Which sphere includes all living things?
items.qAf: Watter sfeer sluit alle lewende dinge in?
items.explain: The biosphere is the zone where life exists, overlapping with the other spheres.
items.explainAf: Die biosfeer is die sone waar lewe bestaan, en dit oorvleuel met die ander sfere.

items.q: A volcano releases gases into the air. Which two spheres are involved?
items.qAf: ŉ Vulkaan stel gasse in die lug vry. Watter twee sfere is betrokke?
items.explain: Volcanoes come from the lithosphere, and the gases they release enter the atmosphere.
items.explainAf: Vulkane kom uit die litosfeer, en die gasse wat hulle vrystel, gaan die atmosfeer in.

items.q: What process turns liquid water into water vapour?
items.qAf: Watter proses verander vloeibare water in waterdamp?
items.explain: Evaporation, including transpiration from plants, turns water into vapour.
items.explainAf: Verdamping, insluitend transpirasie uit plante, verander water in damp.

items.q: Water vapour cools and forms droplets in clouds. What is this called?
items.qAf: Waterdamp koel af en vorm druppels in wolke. Wat word dit genoem?
items.explain: Condensation forms clouds when water vapour cools and changes to liquid droplets.
items.explainAf: Kondensasie vorm wolke wanneer waterdamp afkoel en verander in vloeibare druppels.

items.q: Which process moves water from the soil into plant roots?
items.qAf: Watter proses beweeg water uit die grond in plantwortels?
items.explain: Roots absorb water from the soil, which then moves up the plant.
items.explainAf: Wortels absorbeer water uit die grond, wat dan in die plant opbeweeg.

items.q: The layer of gases surrounding the Earth.
items.qAf: Die laag gasse wat die Aarde omring.

items.q: All the water on Earth, including oceans, rivers and ice.
items.qAf: Al die water op die Aarde, insluitend oseane, riviere en ys.

items.q: The solid, rocky outer layer of the Earth.
items.qAf: Die vaste, rotsagtige buitenste laag van die Aarde.

items.q: All the living things on Earth.
items.qAf: Al die lewende dinge op die Aarde.

items.text: In the water cycle, water [[]] from the sea, then [[]] to form clouds.
items.textAf: In die watersiklus [[]] water uit die see, en [[]] dan om wolke te vorm.

items.text: Water that falls from clouds as rain, hail or snow is called [[]]. Plants release water vapour through their leaves by [[]].
items.textAf: Water wat as reën, hael of sneeu uit wolke val, word [[]] genoem. Plante stel waterdamp deur hul blare vry deur [[]].

items.q: The four spheres of the Earth work separately and do not affect each other.
items.qAf: Die vier sfere van die Aarde werk afsonderlik en beïnvloed mekaar nie.
items.explain: False. They interact all the time, for example water from the hydrosphere evaporates into the atmosphere.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Hulle is heeltyd in wisselwerking, byvoorbeeld water uit die hidrosfeer verdamp in die atmosfeer in.

items.q: The Sun provides the energy that drives the water cycle.
items.qAf: Die Son verskaf die energie wat die watersiklus aandryf.
items.explain: True. The Sun's heat evaporates water.
items.explainAf: Waar. Die Son se hitte laat water verdamp.

items.q: Most of the Earth's water is fresh water.
items.qAf: Die meeste van die Aarde se water is varswater.
items.explain: False. About 97% is salt water in the oceans.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Omtrent 97% is soutwater in die oseane.

items.q: Put the steps of the water cycle in order, starting with the sea.
items.qAf: Rangskik die stappe van die watersiklus in volgorde, begin by die see.
steps: Water in the sea is heated by the Sun
Water vapour cools and condenses into clouds
Run-off and groundwater flow back to the sea
stepsAf: Water in die see word deur die Son verhit
Waterdamp koel af en kondenseer tot wolke
Afloop en grondwater vloei terug na die see

items.q: Give ONE example of how the biosphere affects the atmosphere, and ONE of how the atmosphere affects the hydrosphere.
items.qAf: Gee EEN voorbeeld van hoe die biosfeer die atmosfeer beïnvloed, en EEN van hoe die atmosfeer die hidrosfeer beïnvloed.
points: Biosphere → atmosphere: plants take in CO₂ and release O₂ (photosynthesis) / animals release CO₂ / transpiration adds water vapour.
Atmosphere → hydrosphere: rain/precipitation fills rivers and oceans / wind makes waves.
pointsAf: Biosfeer → atmosfeer: plante neem CO₂ op en stel O₂ vry (fotosintese) / diere stel CO₂ vry / transpirasie voeg waterdamp by.
Atmosfeer → hidrosfeer: reën/neerslag vul riviere en oseane / wind maak golwe.
